title: The Sacred Books of the East - The Qur'an Part II
author: E. H. Palmer (trans)
description: The Qur'an, Part II, translated by E. H. Palmer, being Volume IX of The Sacred Books of the East edited by F. Max Müller (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1880). Edward Henry Palmer (1840-1882), Cambridge orientalist and Lord Almoner's Professor of Arabic, produced a translation praised for its vigorous, literal rendering of the Qur'an's rhetorical power. This second volume covers chapters (surahs) XVII to CXIV, from the Night Journey (al-Isra) and the Cave (al-Kahf), with its stories of the Seven Sleepers, Moses and Khidr and Dhu'l-Qarnayn, through the surahs of Mary, the Prophets, Light, the Merciful and Yasin, to the short Meccan surahs on the Day of Judgement, the Unity of God and the final protective chapters. Footnotes explain allusions and variants. The Sacred Books of the East was the defining Victorian collection of Asian scripture in translation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). The PDF is a scan; the EPUB is derived from OCR text and its quality is limited—consult the PDF for the faithful page.
rights: E. H. Palmer's translation was published in 1880 (Sacred Books of the East, vol. 9); public domain in the USA as a pre-1929 publication.
